plugins.description: Build and maintain a health-insurance knowledge base for an Agentic RAG system: scaffold, ingest files and URLs into per-carrier folders, refresh, list, query and compare plans. The company folder is the unit of parallelism; cost arithmetic is deterministic Python; an unstated value is TBD, never a guess.
